full_judgment: 16. Now we consider the instant civil revision. Plaint case briefly, is this. Bhawal Raj Court of Wards Estate was the owner of the suit property at the time of C S operation. Anand Lal Dhupi took pattan thereof on 24-5-32. By an unregistered deed of sale dated 1-1-43 Ananda sold the property to Nazrul Islam who accordingly possessed the same and got his name recorded in RS Khatian. Plaintiff purchased the suit property from Nazrul Islam by a registered sale deed on 5-7-93. Thus the plaintiff is now the owner of the suit property, but the defendants are trying to lease out the same. Bhawal Raj Court of Wards Estate, Dhaka Division Commissioner and Chairman of Land Reform Board are the defendants in the suit.
